entry_rationale: Empty sidecar. Deploy $55m of the $100m gross cap in the single cleanest USD spot: long USDCAD. Size is below cap to leave room if energy/CAD covering volatility rises, but large enough versus 3.85% SOFR vig if spot continues the incomplete 3m reversal. Trusted code must transact at the packet mid; no authored mark.
entry_thesis: USD policy/labor premium versus a cheap BoC is already extreme in CA-US 2Y and SOFR-CORRA; express it in USDCAD spot, not a cross and not more curve.
